metadata.description: Overrides the @nx/vitest-inferred target's `inputs`, which only cover this project's own files. The configuration key registry tests (src/lib/registry) read two things outside it: `.env.example` (every stable key appears there) and the developer portal's sources (every `process.env` read there is registered). Without them, editing one would leave this target's cache hash unchanged and replay a stale pass. Setting `inputs` REPLACES the inferred array, so the first six entries are the inferred defaults re-declared.
